title: On-demand manufacturing startup SendCutSend raised $110M co-led by Sequoia, Paradigm, and Stripe co-founders Patrick and John Collison, valuing it at $1B (Kate Clark/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Kate Clark / Wall Street Journal: On-demand manufacturing startup SendCutSend raised $110M co-led by Sequoia, Paradigm, and Stripe co-founders Patrick and John Collison, valuing it at $1B — Custom sheet-metal and parts business is among growing group of U.S. companies making physical goods that have drawn venture-capital backing
